responsibility: Defines the Arm VxWorks driver-only compatibility options that select historical VxWorks CPU variants and endianness combinations. It contributes option names such as -t4, -t5, -tstrongarm, and -txscale in both little- and big-endian forms to GCC’s option tables so the driver can recognize and rewrite these VxWorks-specific command-line shorthands.
same_name_distinction: Defines only the VxWorks-specific driver command-line aliases such as -t4 and -txscale for the Arm port, whereas vxworks.h contains the substantive target configuration, specs, and ABI/runtime customizations for VxWorks.
